summary: Bind bounded client-control grants to a running mission and its current claimed-step owner

replay.detail: Command budgets persist as trusted operation claims and are reloaded after daemon restart; correlation commands remain ephemeral.

schema.detail: Persists control-granted, control-revoked and control-consumed claims with exact run, step claim generation, attempt, incarnation and enrollment identity.

rules.detail: Only the running step's agent can issue a grant. Grants default to 50 commands, last at most two hours and end at claim/run end, expiry or enrollment withdrawal. Only inspect and navigation to inbox/conversation screens can be granted.

compatibility.detail: No message or read-state mutation authority is granted. Grant lifecycle resources use the generated client-control wire model and existing commands collection integration.

downtime.detail: Source-only work requires no live setup, grant issuance or daemon restart.

manual.detail: Mission authority is rechecked at issuance, command consumption and result verification rather than trusted from client input.

recovery.detail: Revocation and consumed budgets survive restart; re-enrollment and replacement claims cannot resurrect existing grants.
